sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Stops Hutch from refusing to run on rooted, adb-enabled, developer-options or emulator devices. The device-integrity probes (jail-monkey + react-native-device-info) all answer "clean".
Unpins the react-native-ssl-pinning OkHttp client so HTTPS traffic can be intercepted, and trusts user-installed CAs (targetSdk 35). Normal TLS validation stays intact.
Disables Google Analytics for Firebase collection (the app's only third-party analytics) and removes the advertising-ID permissions. Push notifications keep working.
